scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Asian drama, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Exact normalized title/aliases first, deduplicated by catalogue ID. A single exact title is accepted regardless of year or season. Only multiple title candidates use season then year to disambiguate; ambiguous results remain rejected. Detail ID/title/media type and exact unique episode checks retained; no episode offsets. Parallel video/EN-MS subtitle APIs with local token generation. Subtitle URLs and generic AES configuration unchanged. No added metadata/media requests, no VUEO changes. Existing mapping cache namespace reset.

scrapers.name: OneTouchTV
scrapers.description: Asian drama, anime, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Exact normalized title/aliases and media type first. One unique catalogue ID ignores year/season; multiple candidates use season then year. Exact episode number first: a single match ignores season; duplicate numbers use season; remaining ambiguity rejected. Detail ID/title/type checks retained. Existing API/decryption, playback headers, subtitle handling and cache behavior unchanged except mapping namespace reset. No extra requests, media probes or VUEO changes. Device playback unverified.

scrapers.name: HDHub4u
scrapers.description: Simple HDHub4u WATCH-only HTTP stream extraction
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: New standalone WATCH-only engine. Shared VUEO metadata -> one HTML title search on new9.hdhub4u.cl -> one detail page -> one hdstream4u WATCH page -> extracted HLS URLs and available EN/MS sidecars. Optional TMDB metadata fallback only. No legacy engines, domain-list discovery, search API, download gates/mirrors, collection grace, HLS/segment/file/seek probes or WebView. HLS output is not playback-verified. Movie title/year and explicit TV season/episode required. Fixed current domain must be updated if it changes. Android playback/buffering not established by extraction tests.

scrapers.name: MovieBox
scrapers.description: MovieBox signed mobile API with existing H5 mirror discovery fallback
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Isolated signed mobile resolver followed by bounded existing H5/website fallback; no parallel alternate engines. Shared metadata identity checks, exact aliases/year/type, exact TV resource episode filtering and early pagination exit. Local verification keyed by signed URL/resource ID; HTML/image/JSON CDN responses rejected. Mobile captions bound to selected resource. Explicit foreign audio rejected; unknown audio not labeled Original. 18.5s deadline, request caps and portable existing signing retained. Playback pending device test. Bounded 1080p diagnostics: per-page matching/audio counts, resource rejection reasons before dedupe, requested versus actual resolution, selection counts and CDN status/MIME/size outcome. Selection policy and HTTP request count unchanged.

scrapers.name: 4KHDHub
scrapers.description: Movie and TV stream provider
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Website engine rebuilt: exact search title/year/type and season/episode releases; portable public gate decoder; deterministic HubCloud download routes, no Greenmotors article crawling. HEAD/ranged media verification; original language selection and release quality labels; shared metadata and display preserved. 18.5s request-scoped budget, two workers and cancellation. No confirmed public catalogue API; Android playback requires testing. 2.0.1: normalize nested/flat/string shared metadata, validate title before searching, bounded async metadata bridge and TMDB fallback for incomplete context. Distinct missing-metadata logs. 2.0.2: website-published exact Watch Online iframe first through existing WebView bridge; captured media validation and session headers/subtitles. Download fallback stops both workers after first validated file. Supports movie-card anchor roots. Browser capture/playback requires Android testing. 2.0.3: opt into generic session response capture and reuse matching successful HLS text body if provided; otherwise keep native validation. Normalize subtitle language/lang, MIME and per-track headers without extra caption requests. Actual bridge HLS-body availability and Android cue display remain unverified. 2.0.4: user-requested English/Malay external subtitle allowlist. Reject all other languages and unidentified und tracks. Language identity must come from supplied metadata/label, not guessed from video.

scrapers.name: PencuriMovie
scrapers.description: Malaysia and Indonesia movie and TV streams with multi-server playback
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: No media probes or legacy rescan. Parallel mirrors have independent 6.5s limits, no 400ms first-result cutoff. GET page promises reused by URL and headers within scan only; request timeout 3.5s, abort when available. Playmogo recognized as Dood family. Existing HGCloud fallback retained because live loader script returned 403; no unverified new API. Live samples: Playmogo challenge, Streamtape unavailable, VOE 404. Server labels/headers preserved; no VUEO/subtitle changes. Extraction and playback remain device dependent.

scrapers.name: MSM21
scrapers.description: Malay subtitle movie and TV streams using Zeta player multi-server extraction
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: V17.1 latest-merge repair: restores the repo-wide TMDB title profile and required fast/discovery-rebuild contracts that were lost when the targeted V17 files were overlaid onto an older provider baseline. V16 Provider Repair: DNS-dead mirrors are remembered for the current execution so repeated PlayerX failures do not waste the remaining extractor budget; healthy mirrors such as Netu remain eligible. V15 Shared Discovery Context: TMDB detail metadata is coalesced by VUEO core once per scan when the V15 runtime bridge is available; local TMDB fallback remains for older runtimes. V15 centralized trace hooks emit metadata/candidate/verification stages without changing source extraction. V15 Shared Discovery Context + centralized trace hooks. TMDB metadata is coalesced by VUEO core when available, with provider-local fallback retained. Candidate/verification stages emit lightweight diagnostics. Discovery Rebuild V1: supports both legacy display-item and current ml-item/canonical archive cards, searches more TMDB aliases, cleans release noise before scoring, and falls back to the TV/movie archive before declaring a title missing. Test-Plugin adaptation: transferred engine first (11s maximum), existing Cloudbank engine retained as fallback (7.5s maximum). Shared metadata, provider identity and display preserved; Android playback unverified.

scrapers.name: Castle
scrapers.description: Multi Lang provider
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Castle 2.2.0 verified pipeline: exact normalized TMDB title/original/alias matching, movie/TV validation, revalidated detail IDs, season-1 release-year validation and explicit requested season/episode routing. Large integer IDs preserved as strings before JSON parsing. Current api.hlowb.com security/search/detail/getVideo2 routes and local AES/JNI retained. One 17.5s scan budget covers metadata, key, search, details, decryption and bounded parallel video requests. Shared plus individual audio supported; valid completed sources retained. Preview/denied/blacklisted/expired responses rejected; one videoUrl is emitted once at requested/returned quality, distinct quality URLs preserved. Playback headers and merged video/episode subtitles retained. Android playback unverified.

scrapers.name: MoviesDrive
scrapers.description: MoviesDrive website route; H.264 preferred with validated quality/codec alternatives; original, dual including original and unknown audio; minimum 720p
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Bounded parallel quality extraction: three highest-priority routes processed concurrently, each preserving archive → HubCloud → download → media-probe dependencies. Fourth route starts only as fallback after first batch settles. Retains up to three validated distinct codec/quality files, H.264 ranking and honest codec labels, partial results on failures, 18.7-second total/5.5-second extra collection budgets, exact matching/audio policy and all prior removals. Adds host/total timing logs. v4.1.0 on-device log confirmed three playable sources and subtitle cues; v4.2.0 device timing still needs confirmation.

scrapers.name: Movies4u
scrapers.description: Movies and exact TV episodes through the Movies4u website and HubCloud direct files
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: IMDb-first identity and exact episodes retained. Parser reuses the verified post DOM and scans only IMDb anchors. Optional existing vueoMetadataCache bridge caches public discovery metadata in app memory: domain/post routes up to 5min, file routes 2min; every host, generated token, signed media URL and byte-range probe stays fresh. Cache scope includes current TMDB identity/language/season/episode and active site. Invalid/no-media entries are cleared. Without the bridge, runtime-local caching and normal discovery remain. Minimum 720p, original/dual/unknown accepted, H.264 preferred with 3 parallel host routes. Device timing/playback requires testing.

scrapers.name: Movix VF
scrapers.description: Original-audio Movies and TV: VOSTFR/VO, verified original-language multi-audio; foreign dubs excluded
scrapers.author: wooodyhood
scrapers.notes: Imported from D3adlyRocket/All-in-One-Nuvio at 3f09a6ff4360498895e622877af7a32212f75038. Cloudbank adapter preserves upstream extraction/settings, uses shared TMDB detail metadata when available, caps async result wait at 19s, and returns valid stream arrays. Playback and host settings support require app testing. Cloudbank 1.1.0 original-audio policy filters foreign VF dubs before resolution, verifies original audio in ambiguous MULTI HLS masters, and falls back on empty original-only results.

scrapers.name: PlayIMDb
scrapers.description: High-Speed Direct Streaming for Movies (IMDb ID Extract)
scrapers.author: PirateZoro9
scrapers.notes: Imported from D3adlyRocket/All-in-One-Nuvio at 3f09a6ff4360498895e622877af7a32212f75038. Cloudbank adapter preserves upstream extraction/settings, uses shared TMDB detail metadata when available, caps async result wait at 19s, and returns valid stream arrays. Playback and host settings support require app testing.

scrapers.name: VidRock
scrapers.description: Original adaptive HLS masters returned directly; player chooses quality
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: v4.0.0: return the original HLS master URL immediately after fetching and parsing that playlist, with explicit HLS MIME and website headers. Do not fetch rendition playlists, segments, AES media keys or init segments during source discovery. Preserve all master quality/audio choices and mark adaptive sources Auto; available/max quality are advertised metadata, not a selected resolution or media probe. Remove the 720p minimum and rendition recipe/probe pipeline per user priority for speed. Direct media HLS is returned unchanged after playlist syntax/non-empty checks. JSON quality lists still require selecting one listed URL when no master is provided. Keep API URL authentication/public key refresh, exact identity route, audio policy, three concurrent routes, up to three sources and total deadline. Subtitle implementation is unchanged from v3.0.0/3.1.0. No VUEO app changes. Playback verification now belongs to the player; broken child/segment URLs are not tested in provider discovery.

scrapers.name: VidLink
scrapers.description: Vidlink streaming with encrypted TMDB ID support for movies and TV shows
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Consolidated same-session API/media extraction. No separate API request or forced playback environment. Captured API token decoded to verify requested TMDB and TV route; explicit metadata conflicts rejected. MPD/DASH, HLS and MP4 supported with actual request or successful response observation, then one bounded native HTTP check. Requires consolidated v5 companion sessionResponseVersion=1. No subtitle fetch, retries, domain/provider/movie constants in native app. Native playback and segment access still require device verification.

scrapers.name: VidSrc
scrapers.description: Current website session; direct captured HLS handoff with no token replay or media probes
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Uses the current website in one session with generic frame-local Play selectors. Requires separate VUEO frame-interaction bridge patch. Explicit Play button clicked after document readiness; exact player iframe and bootstrap/player/API request counters logged. No coordinate clicks, separate API replay or master/child/segment/subtitle probes. Unknown audio accepted; playback and device speed unverified. No generic binary transport required by this route. v3.2.1 adds opt-in player document lifecycle, verification/UI events, stream-query requests, script/runtime errors and classified client-restriction signals through separate generic VUEO stage diagnostics v2. Diagnostic update, not confirmed playback fix.

scrapers.name: VixSrc
scrapers.description: VixSrc original adaptive master HLS through the current website API and embed.
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Current website API -> mapped embed -> original adaptive master, two HTTP reads, no WebView/media probes/variants/subtitle requests or signed cache. v2.0.2 fixes a reproduced VUEO runtime compatibility bug: detached URL.searchParams mutations were lost by URL.toString(), dropping token/expires from the returned master. Signed query is now serialized explicitly, tested with the actual VUEO URL shim as well as Node URL. Existing generic shared playback HTTP transport retained. Unknown audio accepted; no provider/title/device hardcode in VUEO. Live website master returned HTTP 200 HLS; corrected Android playback still requires device testing.

scrapers.name: VidFast
scrapers.description: VidFast current website session with original adaptive master capture.
scrapers.author: Dustincos
scrapers.notes: Rebuilt resolver: one exact TMDB movie/episode website session on vidfast.vc, site JavaScript owns its current decoding and stream requests. External decrypt API and master/variant probes removed. Original captured URL/signature and media headers retained; basic/detailed browser result handling; unknown audio allowed, explicit dub-only rejected. No native HTTP calls, token replay, metadata/subtitle fetches or app patch. Fixture tests include the actual VUEO URL compatibility shim. Cloud test browser remained at Fetching, so live media capture and playback are not verified; Android device testing is required.

scrapers.name: VidLove
scrapers.description: Fast exact-TMDB API with one website-session fallback when native engines fail.
scrapers.author: Jeff
scrapers.notes: Video and one English/Malay subtitle-list request start in parallel. Return immediately on eligible video with only already-parsed subtitle tracks; never wait for captions. Pending subtitle work is aborted where supported and released by VUEO execution teardown. No-video result cancels subtitle work. Normal subtitles payload only; no deferred VUEO API or player patch required. Original video/audio/quality and website fallback behavior retained. Late captions are intentionally omitted.

scrapers.name: XPass
scrapers.description: Current XPass website: signed authenticated data index, then playlist sources.
scrapers.author: Dustincos
scrapers.notes: Dynamic website loader/build discovery; AES-GCM authenticated index; up to three server requests in parallel; first eligible server; retains HLS/DASH masters and playlist subtitle headers. No media probes; playback unverified.

scrapers.name: Mapple
scrapers.description: Mapple multi-hoster movies and TV streaming with PoW session verification and direct HLS streams
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: One exact current /watch/movie/id or /watch/tv/id-season-episode session via existing generic webviewResolve bridge. Website owns cookies, tokens, normal verification and Web Worker PoW; no provider-JS hash loop or token/API replay. Capture original HTTP media URL/headers; reject ads/segments/blob/failed or explicitly unobserved candidates. EN/MS source-labelled sidecars retained with bounded parallel metadata reads. No VUEO code patch. Current website browser playback previously observed; Android WebView capture/playback still requires testing.

scrapers.name: Vidnest
scrapers.description: Vidnest streaming with encrypted AES-GCM sources
scrapers.author: Nuvio Team
scrapers.notes: Current new.vidnest.fun v2 API for website-mapped yflix/flixhq/vidzee routes. Local SHA-256/AES-256-GCM with authentication-tag checks using existing CryptoJS; no Node crypto/process.env, decrypt service, legacy proxy, WebView or app change. Exact TMDB/season/episode routes; source headers/captions retained; bounded parallel API calls, HLS root check or video HEAD, no 403 acceptance or segment probes. Sample Venom APIs decrypt; FlixHQ HLS 200 and VidZee MKV HEAD 200 observed; Android playback and full catalog unverified. v2.0.1: isolated provider-owned CryptoJS primitives replace unavailable runtime algo.AES; regression tests forbid all runtime module access. API routes and selection unchanged. v2.1.0: EN/MS-only subtitles from source API plus parallel VDRK v1/v2 sidecar metadata (3.5s total subtitle budget). Exact movie/episode path, URL dedupe, up to 8 tracks/language; failures preserve video. Wyzie excluded because current frontend key is rejected. Existing v2.0.1 video decoder/resolver unchanged. v2.1.1: preserve source subtitle label/display/name verbatim; no translated labels or added CC/variant labels. EN/MS filter retained. v2.2.0: collect completed sources for at most 600ms after first verified result; finish sooner with two sources and EN/MS captions. Stop caption lookup after both languages arrive. Snapshot available captions without waiting for subtitle promises; cancel pending HTTP/local waits and ignore late results. Source URLs, video checks, isolated decrypt and source subtitle labels unchanged.

scrapers.name: KShow123
scrapers.description: Korean variety shows with exact title and episode mapping
scrapers.author: kurato-svg
scrapers.notes: v1.0.2: Isolated provider-owned CryptoJS AES/OpenSSL decoder avoids runtime crypto-module compatibility. Parser accepts reordered/quoted player file properties. Diagnostics distinguish unmatched response, iframe embed, AES failure and decoded URL without exposing tokens. Existing exact title/episode mapping retained. Android playback requires verification.

scrapers.name: VidZee
scrapers.description: Movie and TV streams via direct TMDB routes; playlist-based resolution detection
scrapers.author: kurato-svg
scrapers.notes: v1.0.3: Auto only for verified multi-variant HLS masters; known single-variant resolution uses Np; media-only, MP4 and unreadable playlists use Unknown. Maximum advertised master resolution in source title/log. Preserves v1.0.2 URLs, headers, no-dub policy and no segment probes. App-side current playback dimensions require separate VUEO changes.

scrapers.name: VidSrc.to
scrapers.description: Exact TMDB movie/episode embed with native WebView session and HLS validation
scrapers.author: Kurato
scrapers.notes: Recovery: restores the v1.0.0 VidSrc.to WebView entry, Yumeflix Referer and 500ms finish grace. Removes v1.0.1 iframe unwrapping/HTML preflight. Optional subtitle payload validation retained; does not navigate directly to vsembed.ru. Native subtitle capture requires companion app support; standalone subtitle completeness and live recovery require device verification.

scrapers.name: Viduki
scrapers.description: Exact TMDB API 1 streaming player with parallel website subtitles
scrapers.author: Cloudbank
scrapers.notes: English/Malay subtitle URLs passed to VUEO directly; no subtitle file fetch or cue-regex validation. Subtitle index runs alongside discovery and is stopped at discovery end. Video route unchanged.
